arguments.text: Independent aggregation verified55 polynomial families, with52 covering834 residues modulo840 and three extra lifts. The exact uncovered residues are1,121,169,289,361,529; the smallest n>=3 in every included progression was checked. Window evidence establishes minimal first denominators285 at1129,306 at1201 and61570 at246241. 4597 inputs were tested for the eight-step route, including an unbroken4166-input prefix25..99985 before the targeted counterexample. Architecture1.12 now supports native finite/window/scan/family tools and bounded hashed task/proof memory. Full regression211 tests and28 assurance cases passed after restoring backward-compatible scope wording. No human review, novelty claim or original-goal resolution.
